persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. No photo—use a plain white leather low-top with white laces and a white sole, no logo. Three moving shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep all captions at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won't cover them.
bank.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
bank.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
bank.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
bank.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
bank.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
bank.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a sneaker ad, and I don't have a photo, so please generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole, and no logo. I've been thinking about this little ad for a while and am excited to see it come together. What I need is a silent 15-second 9:16 video with three moving shots of the product. The captions should appear in this exact order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”. My main worry is that reel buttons might cover the words when someone watches it. Please keep every caption, including its full text bounds, at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so those buttons won't cover them.
